# Time Travel inspector

Source: https://github.com/lostbean/timetravel
Revision: 87a367680c1193228db8d6c791611b7514efdc86
Upstream: https://github.com/bmehder/timetravel
Upstream base: 24db1c91d98e485e194ec8ff6710dfd420aee229
License: MIT, original LICENSE retained.

Only the inspector source is vendored for a reproducible example dependency.
The fork's experimental recording module is deliberately excluded; Retrace owns
recording. Local modifications: none. The source includes the fork's negative
seek fix and configurable history capacity. No upstream PR has been opened.
